basic_info.description: The NE555 is a precision timing circuit capable of producing accurate time delays or oscillation. It operates from 5V to 15V supply, supports monostable and astable modes with adjustable duty cycle, and features TTL-compatible output capable of sinking or sourcing up to 200mA. Suitable for pulse shaping, frequency division, and industrial control applications.

pin_configuration.name: TRIG
pin_configuration.description: Start of timing input. TRIG < ½ CONT sets output high and discharge open

pin_configuration.name: RESET
pin_configuration.description: Active low reset input forces output and discharge low

pin_configuration.name: CONT
pin_configuration.description: Controls comparator thresholds, Outputs 2/3 × VCC, allows bypass capacitor connection

pin_configuration.name: THRES
pin_configuration.description: End of timing input. THRES > CONT sets output low and discharge low

pin_configuration.name: DISCH
pin_configuration.description: Open collector output to discharge timing capacitor

pin_configuration.name: VCC
pin_configuration.description: Input supply voltage, 4.5V to 16V. SE555 maximum is 18V

seo.meta_description_en: NE555 precision timer IC with adjustable duty cycle, TTL-compatible output (200mA), and timing from microseconds to hours. Ideal for pulse shaping, frequency division, and industrial controls. Available in SOIC, PDIP, and TSSOP packages.
seo.meta_description_zh: NE555精密定时器IC，支持可调占空比，TTL兼容输出（200mA），定时范围从微秒到小时。适用于脉冲整形、频率分频和工业控制。提供SOIC、PDIP和TSSOP封装。
